# Green Dragonfly Holistics

> Green Dragonfly Holistics offers relaxation therapies for people seeking calm and restoration, including sound baths, Reiki, and ASMR massage near Glasgow. Located in East Renfrewshire. Offers therapies in Newton Mearns and Barrhead.

## Services

- [Green Dragonfly Holistics](https://greendragonflyholistics.com/): Relaxation therapies including sound baths with singing bowls, gongs, and other therapeutic instruments, Reiki, and ASMR massage.
